connector.name: AxioRank: Zero-Trust for AI Agents
connector.registryDescription: Zero-trust gateway for AI agents: score tool calls, verify agent cards, enforce policy, audit.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.axiorank.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.axiorank, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: AxioRank API key as a Bearer token (axr_live_…), required for tool calls (the handshake and tool listing are public). Create one in your AxioRank dashboard under Settings → API keys.
